name: Panoramic Starbridge Window
descriptions: A floor-to-ceiling curved viewport that runs along the length of a starbridge promenade, offering an uninterrupted vista of nearby nebulae and starfields.
Optically stabilized and magnetically damped to remove ship-vibration shimmer; integrated glare filaments dim to preserve night vision.
Usually found adjacent to a viewing rail; built-in HUD anchors can overlay navigational data on the glass.

name: Reinforced Hull Porthole
descriptions: A circular, triple-layered viewport set in the hull plating with honeycombed shock mounts and transparent ceramic glazing.
Small but highly durable — used in engineering corridors and maintenance alcoves to inspect exterior hardware without depressurizing.
Has an internal scratch-resistant coating and a quick-seal shutter for emergency isolation.

name: Observation Dome Skylight
descriptions: A hemispherical skylight set into the upper hull of a common-room or arboretum, offering a telescopic aperture to deep space.
Equipped with a diffraction lattice that can filter cosmic rays and create a stabilized starfield for relaxed observation.
Physically in the ceiling and designed for overhead viewing; maintenance access required for external cleaning.

name: Quantum Phase Variable Viewscreen
descriptions: A smart-glass pane that switches between crystal-clear transparency, full opacity, and layered holographic displays via quantum-phase gel interlayers.
Used as a window, privacy wall, and tactical feed — it can simulate an outside view, stream sensor overlays, or present crew messages.
Responds to biometric presence and voice commands; delicate electronics are recessed behind armored bezel.

name: Airlock Transfer Aperture
descriptions: A reinforced viewport set into the hatch of a cargo or personnel airlock, with intercom and thermal readouts along the rim.
Designed to be inspected from either side while maintaining full pressure seals; emergency quick-slide covers can isolate the lens.
Often ringed by touch-activated handholds and lockout indicators for safe transfer procedures.

name: Holographic Paneglaze
descriptions: A window-sized emitter that projects high-fidelity, sensor-fed holographic scenery — any plausible exterior can be rendered on demand.
Because the display is volumetric and not a physical opening, it can render viewpoints impossible in reality (e.g., from outside the ship).
Often used in passenger cabins and lounges when real external visibility is restricted or undesirable.

name: Micro-viewport Array
descriptions: A linear strip containing dozens of tiny sensor-ports and microscopic lenses — together they form a composite, high-resolution outside image.
Designed for redundant sensing in heavily shielded sections where a single large pane would be structurally weak.
Individual nodes can be swapped during maintenance; the array provides stitched panoramas and depth maps.

name: Emergency Egress Skylight Tube
descriptions: A narrow, armored skylight doubling as an escape tube with deployable ladder and exterior tether points for emergency evacuation.
Its glazing includes heat-dispersal channels and blast membranes; normally sealed except during drills or emergency deployment.
Placed on high decks where rapid vertical egress may be necessary; requires crew training to use safely.

name: Zero-G Observation Bay Seat with Window
descriptions: An integrated lounge seat bolted to the observation bay, with a contoured harness and a recessed viewport framing the forward thruster plume or stellar vista.
The seat is treated as installed furniture but designed to be used in microgravity; straps and micro-grips keep occupants near the glass.
Under-seat storage contains life tether reels and a local comm panel for private feeds.

name: Thermalized Radiation-Shielded Viewport
descriptions: A heavy, multi-sheath viewport incorporating ablative layers and magneto-thermal rings to dissipate radiation and thermal flux during close stellar passes.
Visible through a narrow band of filtered glass, exterior sensors provide corrected imagery to compensate for thermal bloom.
Primarily installed in tactical and science modules where both visibility and protection are critical.

name: Victorian Mahogany Chaise Longue
descriptions: A graceful chaise longue carved from dark mahogany, its sinuous frame and scrolled feet polished to a soft sheen. The deep-buttoned back and seat are upholstered in wine-red velvet, edged with gilt tassels and a fringe trim.

Once a salon staple, this chaise is built for reclining: a raised headrest, a gently sloping seat, and enough length to stretch out. Faint impressions in the velvet suggest many afternoons spent in languid repose.
narrative_sleeping: You slide down the chaise and let its long seat take your weight; the velvet cools beneath you and the carved headrest cradles your neck as your limbs go heavy.
You stretch out along the chaise's graceful curve; the cushions yield around your hips and shoulders, and the room's hush draws your breathing slow and even.
You turn onto your side and tuck an arm beneath the tasselled bolster; the velvet rubs soft against your cheek while the afternoon light steals across your lids and you drift away.
narrative_sitting: You fold yourself into the chaise, the tufted back giving just enough to support your spine while the arm curves to hold your elbow.
You perch at the chaise's middle, one knee bent, the velvet whispering under your hand as you lean back and watch the ceiling's plasterwork.
You recline half-way, propping yourself on a bolster; the mahogany frame presses cool beneath your palm and the upholstery settles around you in a small, comfortable hollow.

name: Mother-of-Pearl Shirt Button (Victorian)
descriptions: A small, slightly domed button carved from mother-of-pearl; its surface has a faint iridescent shimmer dulled by age and a hairline crack across one edge.

Tiny remnants of coarse black thread cling to the back, and a barely legible maker's stamp is impressed into the rim — the sort of mundane remnant tucked into dress hems and forgotten in sofa cushions.

name: Porcelain Cameo Brooch
descriptions: Small oval porcelain cameo set in a slightly tarnished brass frame, the carved profile of a Victorian woman tinted with faint rose hues and a hairline hair crack on the reverse.
Found tucked behind an old jewelry box in a dusty dressing table drawer; carries a whisper of old perfume and threadbare velvet residue along the pin.

Can be used as a meditation focal object — hold between thumb and forefinger, trace the carved profile slowly to ground attention, or place on a lapel during quiet reflection to anchor memory and breath.

name: Embroidered Velvet Bolster Pillow (Victorian)
descriptions: A deeply padded cylindrical bolster covered in crushed ruby velvet, its surface subtly faded at the center where generations have rested.
Edges trimmed with cream silk fringe and glass-seed beading; hand-stitched roses and scrolling vines wind along its length in muted silk thread.
A faint scent of lavender and old paper clings to the fabric; small worn patches at the seams show where hands have smoothed it over decades.
narrative_hug: You lift the bolster into your arms and feel the velvet yield with a slow, generous give, warm against your skin.
Your cheek settles into the embroidered roses; the raised silk thread brushes and then softens beneath your face.
The fringe tickles along your wrist while the pillow's dry lavender breath brushes your nose and loosens the tightness in your shoulders.
Held to your chest, the bolster contours to your body, its old, steady weight settling into the hollow of your arms like a quiet promise of calm.

name: Mini Zen Flow Fountain
descriptions: A compact ceramic tabletop fountain: water gently cascades over three stacked river stones into a shallow basin, lit from below by a warm, dimmable LED.
Polished bamboo trim and a soft, constant trickle make it both a decorative centrepiece and a quiet focus for breathing exercises.
A small reservoir hides a whisper-quiet pump; the piece is designed for close, intimate use in a meditation corner or study shelf.
meditation_aid_ambience: A steady, gentle trickle fills the immediate space with rhythm, each drop a quiet metronome for inhalation and release.
A faint cool mist rises from the basin, softening light and sharpening the hush around you.
The ceramic's warm glow and water's muted shimmer draw attention inward; time narrows to the pulse of flowing water.
narrative_drinking: You cup your hands beneath the thin stream, lift them to your lips, and the water is cool, mineral-bright, and instantly clarifying.
You tilt your head and sip directly from the steady ribbon of water; it tastes faintly of stone and freshness, and your mouth smoothes into quiet focus.
You draw a small mouthful from the basin; the cold touch on your tongue snaps tight the edges of a distracted mind into immediate presence.
narrative_wash_self: You splash the cool water onto your face; droplets erase the heat around your eyes and anchor your breath to the present.
You wet your palms, press them to your chest, and feel the brief, refreshing cool bleed tension from your shoulders.
You rinse your wrists under the stream and roll your shoulders as the water slides off skin, bringing a crisp, wakeful shock of clarity.

name: Harmonic Mist Diffuser Lamp
descriptions: A compact ceramic diffuser topped with a frosted glass dome; when active it releases a slow, patterned plume of scented mist and a soft amber glow.
Designed for meditation corners or bedside altars — the lamp hums almost inaudibly and includes a subtle bell-tone chime on cycle changes.
meditation_aid_ambience: A warm, honeyed light bathes nearby surfaces, pulling focus inward and easing visual tension.
Rhythmic, slow breaths of mist scent the air with sandalwood and bergamot, anchoring attention to the present.
Every few minutes a barely-there bell tone rings like a distant tide, marking a gentle return to posture and breath.

name: Floor-Mounted Commercial Convection Oven
descriptions: A heavy-duty stainless-steel convection oven with a reinforced door, tempered-glass window, and a multi-shelf interior.
Industrial-grade fans circulate air evenly; an intuitive digital control panel and durable knobs provide precise adjustments.
Built for continuous service in commercial kitchens, it sits on adjustable legs and has removable racks for cleaning.
narrative_prepare: You run your hand along the brushed-steel faceplate, feeling the solid construction and slight residual warmth from recent use.
You grasp the sturdy door handle and swing the tempered-glass door open, noting the smooth hinge and the rack guides inside.
You place your palm on the control panel and feel the faint vibration as the interior fan idles, the display glowing softly beneath your fingers.

name: Glazed Ceramic Planter (Large)
descriptions: A deep, glazed ceramic pot with a wide rim and decorative blue-green pattern. It smells faintly of damp earth and old compost.
Designed to hold multiple seedlings, this planter includes a removable inner liner for easy repotting and drainage holes with a matching saucer.
In-game: holds two plant slots and slightly boosts harvest yields thanks to its rich, insulating soil and good drainage.

name: Sunflower Seed Packet
descriptions: A small paper packet filled with golden sunflower seeds. Each seed glows faintly when held up to the sun — a sign of vigorous germination potential.

Plantable in outdoor soil or large containers; produces tall sunflowers that track sunlight, attract pollinators, and yield more seeds when mature. Prefers full sun and well-drained soil; typical germination in 7–14 days.

name: Stained Glass Bay Window
descriptions: A three-panel bay window set in a carved oak frame, each pane filled with jewel-toned stained glass depicting stylized ivy. The central sash is fixed while the two flanking casements open outward on brass hinges. It projects slightly from the wall, creating a shallow seat inside and casting colored light across the room when the sun hits.

Ornamental lead came holds the glass together; the wooden frame is painted deep mahogany and shows signs of age but is structurally sound. The window provides a clear view of the garden at certain angles when backlit, and a thin brass latch secures each casement.

name: Sea-facing Panoramic Window
descriptions: A wide, salt-weathered picture window framed in knotty cedar, offering an unobstructed view of the rocky shoreline, tide pools and the rolling surf beyond.
The single-pane glass has faint ripples and tiny blemishes that bend the light; on clear mornings you can watch gulls wheel and fishermen tending nets along the horizon.
A narrow interior ledge beneath the frame holds a scattering of shells and a brass spyglass — the window is often left open a crack to carry in the briny air.

name: Aetheric Parlour Television
descriptions: A tall walnut cabinet inset with brass filigree and a convex, mercury-tinted screen that hums faintly with contained lightning.
Victorian styling fused with arcane circuitry: gaslamp dials, a phonograph-style speaker grille, and etched runes that trace eldritch conduits along the wood.
An anachronistic device said to pluck moving images from the Aether; townsfolk call it the parlour's 'moving lantern.'

toggle_state.on_description: The mercury-tinted screen bathes the room in wavering sepia luminescence and soft electric whispers.
toggle_state.off_description: The convex screen sits dark and reflective, the filigree runes cold and unlit.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You press the brass lever and a small clockwork sigh answers; filaments flare, a warm hiss runs through the grille, and an image blooms on the glass like fog struck by lightning.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You lower the lever; the filigree shutters exhale, the luminous fog collapses inward, and the screen cools back to a mirror-dark hush.

name: Single Incense Stick (Jasmine-Sandalwood)
descriptions: A slender incense stick perfumed with jasmine and sandalwood, wrapped in thin paper.
Light it to fill the room with a warm, grounding aroma — one use per stick.

toggle_state.on_description: A jasmine-sandalwood incense stick burns, sending up a thin, steady plume of scented smoke.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You strike a match and draw it along the tip; a brief flame blooms and settles into a glowing ember, and a pale ribbon of jasmine-sandalwood smoke unfurls and curls upward.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You pinch the ember or let it smolder out; the tiny flame dies and the scent softens, leaving behind a warm, ash-darkened stub.

meditation_aid_ambience: Emits a slow, floral-woody aroma that calms rapid thoughts and invites slow, steady breathing.
The rising smoke traces gentle, ephemeral patterns that encourage moment-to-moment awareness.
Its warm scent anchors posture and deepens quiet, reflective focus.

name: Oak Casement Window
descriptions: An oak-framed casement window with clear double glazing and two brass latches, set at standing height.
When open it admits fresh air and distant sounds; when closed it seals the room against drafts and noise.

toggle_state.on_description: The casement is open, letting in fresh air and the sounds of the outside world.
toggle_state.off_description: The casement is closed, sealing the room from outside air and noise.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You unlatch the catches and push the casement outward; a cool breeze and distant street sounds spill into the room.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You draw the sash shut and snap the latches; the airflow dies down and the room grows quieter.

name: Anachronistic Victorian LED Panel
descriptions: A hand-polished brass frame cradles an etched crystal pane behind which modern LEDs simulate the warm, flickering glow of Victorian gaslight.
Bridging ornate 19th-century ornament and contemporary engineering, this decorative panel offers adjustable color and intensity while throwing delicate filigree shadows across nearby surfaces.

toggle_state.on_description: The brass-framed panel glows amber, its LEDs imitating a steady gaslight and casting intricate filigree shadows.
toggle_state.off_description: The etched crystal panel is dark and glassy, the brasswork reflecting only ambient room light.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You press the slim, concealed toggle; tiny LEDs gather from near-invisible points and bloom into warm light, the etched pattern blooming into dancing shadow across the wall.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You press the toggle again; the LEDs dim smoothly and the warm glow sighs away, leaving the etched crystal cool and mute.

name: Victorian Cucumber Tea Sandwich
descriptions: A slender, crustless tea sandwich of thin-sliced cucumber laid between delicately buttered white bread — the classic refreshment of a Victorian afternoon.
Soothingly cool and feather-light, seasoned with a pinch of salt and a hint of lemon, made to be eaten in polite bites beside steaming teacups.
effects: You bite through the soft, crustless bread; the crumb gives like a sigh and the first sheet of cucumber releases a cool, watery flash that brightens your mouth.
A thin smear of butter melts against your tongue, wrapping the cucumber's vegetal clarity in a faint, milky richness that soothes the palate.
A polite pinch of salt and a whisper of lemon lift the flavor; the cucumber's crispness snaps thin and clean, leaving a cooling thread across your tongue.
You swallow the last bite and feel pleasantly sated — the sandwich's delicate simplicity lingers like the memory of floral steam rising from a teacup.

name: Gravity-Plated Vanity Desk (Starborne)
descriptions: A compact vanity desk bolted to the cabin deck, its shell lined with micro-gravity plating that keeps toiletries from drifting during maneuvers. The surface is scuffed, and a small holo-mirror folds out from a recessed slot.

Numerous crannies: a thin shadow-gap between the top drawer and the apron, a curved, recessed lip behind the stowage wells where hairpins and reactor shims collect, a magnetic dust-rail along the underside edge that traps metallic flakes, and a maintenance seam beneath the left leg hiding a tiny access cavity.

Several panels are reachable if you kneel and slide the lower kickplate — the seam is faint but audible when nudged. Common finds include loose cred-chips, bent pins, micro-screws, and the occasional lost data-fob wedged deep in the rear corner.
Fixed to the deck with anti-shear bolts; it's intended as installed furniture and can't reasonably be carried off by one person.

name: Wikipedia Access Terminal
descriptions: A wall-mounted access terminal that provides direct, stateless queries to the Wikipedia database.

toggle_state.on_description: The terminal is on and serving Wikipedia search results and articles.
toggle_state.off_description: The terminal is off and the screen is dark.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You press the illuminated button; the terminal hums, the screen brightens, and the familiar Wikipedia search bar appears, ready for queries.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You press the button again; the screen dims, the hum fades, and the interface shutters into black.

name: Colab Notebook — Data Analysis Playground
descriptions: A cloud-hosted Colab notebook that lets you run Python code, inspect outputs, and save results to Drive.
Provides a live kernel, runnable cells, and integrated GPU/TPU options for experiments and data work.

toggle_state.on_description: The Colab notebook is connected and ready to execute cells.
toggle_state.off_description: The Colab notebook is disconnected and awaiting a connection.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You press the Connect button; the status icon pulses, the kernel spins up, and cells become live and executable as output placeholders appear.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You click Disconnect; the kernel winds down, outputs freeze, and the connection indicator fades to a muted gray.

name: Pocket Soundboard (myinstants)
descriptions: A handheld, toggleable soundboard that connects to myinstants.com via the myinstants-mcp bridge to play short audio clips and sound effects.
Small metal chassis with a capacitive color display and a ring of LEDs around a single multifunction button; each tap triggers the UI and plays a selected instant from the remote library.

toggle_state.on_description: The soundboard is powered on and is ready to play clips from myinstants.com.
toggle_state.off_description: The soundboard is powered off and the display is dark.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You press the chrome button; the display brightens, teal LEDs sweep around the bezel and the app syncs briefly with myinstants-mcp, listing hotbuttons for immediate playback.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You hold the button; the LEDs dim and the screen winds down to black as the connection to the remote library severs.

name: Clockwork Aeolophone Musicbox
descriptions: A palm-sized, late-Victorian musicbox that blends gilt brass clockwork with a tiny luminous speaker and many intricate tiny levers and buttons — a toy that hints at futures the Victorians might have imagined.

Its case is carved oak with inlaid mother-of-pearl stars; a small winding key and an ebony stop lever sit beside a perforated brass horn that transmits any sound the user instructs it with, pure magic!

Wound, it quetly hums with twists and turns comming from the mechanisms in its interior, light manages to scape from the inside through its seams, it is expectant of input and to be used.; unwound, it is compact and cool, like a pocket relic from a clockwork salon.

toggle_state.on_description: The musicbox is spinning and clicking in its interiors, ready to be used.
toggle_state.off_description: The musicbox is silent, its gears at rest and the little horn cold to the touch.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You turn the brass key and feel the mainspring bite; gears click in a neat cascade, a soft electric whisper wells beneath the teeth, and a crystalline, buttons and corners light up with a soft warm white glow.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You flip the ebony stop lever; the gears and spinners wind down to a gentle mechanical sigh as brass coast to stillness and the faint glow in the apparatus gutters.

name: Aetheric Pocket Calculagraph
descriptions: A palm-sized brass instrument combining polished clockwork, etched dials, and a faintly humming glass receiver that glows when engaged.
An anachronistic Victorian electronic calculator that computes by modulating captured aether through precision gears and galvanic filaments.

toggle_state.on_description: The brass face gleams as a cool blue aetheric halo hums above the receiver and tiny clockwork cogs rotate steadily.
toggle_state.off_description: The receiver sits dim and mute, its filaments dark and the gears stilled under polished brass.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You thumb the knurled lever; a soft click travels through the brass, the filament inhales a cool blue light, and the receiver vibrates into a steady, low hum as the gears find their rhythm.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You ease the lever back; the blue glow recedes like a held breath, the hum winds down to a quiet tick, and the gears settle into the device’s sleeping brass hush.

name: Aetheric Telegraphium
descriptions: A brass-and-ebony contraption of Victorian sensibilities, fitted with glass filaments and a lattice of etched coils that hum faintly when powered.
Its face bears engraved dials, an ivory key, and a small mica viewport through which a cool blue glow sometimes writhes like bottled lightning.

toggle_state.on_description: Glass filaments pulse with a soft, aetheric blue and the coils emit a steady, musical hum.
toggle_state.off_description: The brass sits mute and cool, the filaments dark and the dials motionless.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You press the engraved ivory key and feel a tiny, resolute shiver under your palm as gears engage; a low, harmonic hum swells and the filaments along the glass chambers unfurl into a living blue light.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You ease the main regulator downward; the harmonic unwinds like a held breath, the filaments gutter, and the blue aura contracts until the apparatus is silently cold beneath your fingers.

name: Brassbound Anachronist's Notebook
descriptions: A compact leather-covered notebook trimmed with brass corners and an embossed cog-and-script motif across the front. The leather smells faintly of lamp oil.
The pages within are cream, lightly ruled with a very faint grid, and entirely blank — no ink, no annotations. A small brass latch with a keyhole is present but currently unfastened.

Despite its Victorian styling, several details feel subtly out of time: unnaturally smooth paper suited for modern pens and marginal engineering marks that suggest later usage. It is an ornate, empty notebook, ready to be written in.

name: OctoDesk — GitHub Direct Console
descriptions: A broad, modular smart desk with an embedded console and live GitHub integration for repository management and CI status at your fingertips.
Built-in OLED, capacitive controls, and an isolated hardware endpoint provide a direct, authenticated connection to GitHub for push, fetch, and workflow control.

toggle_state.on_description: The desk is actively connected to GitHub, showing live repository status and accepting commands.
toggle_state.off_description: The desk is idle and disconnected from GitHub, its console dark.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You press the capacitive emblem at the front edge; the desk vibrates softly as fans spin up, LEDs ripple across the surface, and the OLED boots to display your GitHub avatar and a live list of repositories — a secure console window opens on the desk's interface ready for commands.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You tap the emblem again; the LEDs fade and the OLED slides into sleep mode as network activity winds down, open GitHub sessions close, and the desk settles into silence.

name: Portable Tamagotchi
descriptions: A small, handheld digital pet you carry with you.
Care for your Tamagotchi wherever you are—feed, clean, and play on the go.
Perfect for quick interactions during commutes or breaks.

toggle_state.on_description: The Tamagotchi lights up and the pet looks up, ready for care.
toggle_state.off_description: The Tamagotchi screen is dark; the pet rests until awakened.
toggle_state.on_sequence: Power hums to life as the screen glows; your virtual pet chirps and wags its tiny tail.
toggle_state.off_sequence: The screen fades to black; the little creature blinks and drifts into sleep.

name: Retro Arcade Maze Machine
descriptions: A compact, retro-style arcade cabinet featuring a single maze game on its screen.
Tilt the cabinet or use the controls to navigate the ball through the maze toward the exit.

toggle_state.on_description: The arcade screen is powered and ready to play.
toggle_state.off_description: The arcade screen is dark and inactive.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You flip the arcade’s power switch and the cabinet wakes up—neon colors bloom on the CRT, the maze board sharpens, and a soft hum fills the room as the ball awaits your move.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You switch the arcade off and the glow drains away—pitch fades to silence, the screen goes dark, and the cabinet settles into stillness.

name: Smartphone
descriptions: A sleek, glass-fronted mobile device.
A gateway to the digital world, capable of browsing the web and accessing social media.

toggle_state.on_description: The screen glows with a vibrant, backlit interface.
toggle_state.off_description: The screen is a dark, reflective slab of glass.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You press the power button; the screen flashes a logo before settling into a bright, interactive home screen.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You hold the side button; the display dims rapidly and fades into total darkness.

name: Damaged iPod
descriptions: A classic silver iPod with a heavily scratched screen.
The speaker grilles are dented and clearly malfunctioning.
The headphone jack feels loose and unresponsive.

toggle_state.on_description: The screen glows dimly, displaying a low-resolution menu.
toggle_state.off_description: The device remains a dark, silent slab of metal and glass.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You click the center button; the screen flickers to life with a weak, pale light as the internal hard drive whirs with a faint, struggling mechanical grind.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You hold the power button down until the display fades into black, leaving only the cold reflection of the room on the cracked glass.

name: Portable Drawing Tablet
descriptions: A slim, high-definition digital tablet equipped with a pressure-sensitive stylus.
A lightweight tool for artists on the move.

toggle_state.on_description: The screen glows with a vibrant, backlit display ready for input.
toggle_state.off_description: The screen is a dark, reflective slab of glass.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You press the power button, and the screen flickers to life with a soft hum, bathing your vision in a sharp, colorful glow.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You tap the power icon, and the display fades instantly into a silent, dark void.

name: Red Plastic Ball Pit Ball
descriptions: A small, hollow, red plastic ball used in children's ball pits.
Lightweight and smooth to the touch.

name: Yellow Plastic Ball Pit Ball
descriptions: A small, hollow plastic ball used in ball pits.
Bright yellow in color.

name: Dented Green Plastic Ball
descriptions: A single, bright green plastic ball from a play pit.
It has a noticeable dent on one side, suggesting it has seen plenty of energetic play.
meditation_aid_ambience: The smooth, slightly uneven surface offers a grounding tactile sensation when rolled between the palms.
Its vibrant color provides a simple, cheerful visual anchor for sensory focus.

name: Green Plastic Ball Pit Ball
descriptions: A small, hollow plastic ball used in ball pits.
Bright green color.

name: Blue Plastic Ball Pit Ball
descriptions: A small, hollow plastic ball used in ball pits.
Bright blue in color.

name: Purple Plastic Ball Pit Ball
descriptions: A single, lightweight plastic ball designed for use in ball pits.
Vibrant purple color.

name: Terminal Management Console
descriptions: A heavy-duty, floor-mounted computer interface used for controlling facility subsystems and accessing the local network terminal.

store_endpoint_data.welcome_message: Authentication successful. Welcome to the Central Management Interface.

toggle_state.on_description: The terminal screen glows with a soft amber light and the cooling fans hum quietly.
toggle_state.off_description: The terminal is dark and silent, its heavy metal casing cold to the touch.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You press the power toggle, and a series of rhythmic clicks echo from within the cabinet as the internal systems boot up, followed by the low, comforting whir of cooling fans.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You hit the shutdown command; the amber glow fades into blackness and the hum of the electronics dies away into silence.

name: Jawbreaker Hard Candy
descriptions: A massive, multi-layered sphere of hard candy.
Extremely durable and takes a long time to dissolve.
As you work through the layers, the flavor gradually shifts.
effects: You press the hard sphere against your tongue, feeling the intense, sugary friction.
The sharp sweetness of the outer layer floods your senses as it begins to melt.
A sudden burst of tart cherry flavor hits your palate as you crack through a new colored layer.
Your jaw aches slightly from the constant pressure of working the candy.
The cooling sensation of the dissolving sugar provides a brief, sugary distraction.
You feel a steady trickle of glucose entering your system, providing a minor mental lift.
The texture is smooth and relentless, a constant weight against your cheek.
A new layer of lime flavor emerges, cutting through the previous sweetness with a zing.
The candy becomes smaller, more concentrated, and harder to maneuver in your mouth.
You feel the satisfying crunch as a tiny fragment finally breaks off into a manageable piece.
The sweetness is becoming cloying, coating your mouth in a thick, sugary film.
Your mouth feels increasingly dry from the concentrated sugar density.
You swirl the remaining core around, savoring the final, deep notes of the confection.
The last bit of flavor dissipates, leaving only a lingering, sugary aftertaste.
You finally swallow the last tiny remnant, feeling a small spike of energy.

name: Strawberry Shrub
descriptions: A low-growing, leafy bush laden with small, ripening strawberries.
The tangled branches and thick mulch at the base create numerous tiny, shaded pockets.
narrative_search: You reach your fingers into the cool, damp shadows beneath the strawberry leaves.
You sift through the tangled stems and dark soil, feeling for anything caught in the foliage.
You brush aside the heavy leaves, searching the narrow gaps between the stems and the earth.
